small_guidance:
- The conv kernel does N*ceil(OH*OW/64)*ceil(OC/64) = 128*1024*1 = 131072 programs, each looping IC=64 with KH*KW=9 inner iterations and gather loads — the inner load `tl.load(x_ptr + x_off, ...)` is uncoalesced across BLOCK_HW because ih/iw are computed per-row. Try BLOCK_HW=128, BLOCK_OC=32 with num_warps=8, num_stages=3, and wrap configs in `triton.autotune` over (64/128/256 × 32/64) to find a better tile. Also hoist the bias load outside the IC loop (already done) and move the weight load outside the kw inner static_range when possible.
- Switch the conv input layout to NHWC up front (one-shot transpose of x) so the inner `tl.load` on `x_ptr` is contiguous along channels — turn the IC loop into a tiled GEMM-K with BLOCK_K=16 or 32 so loads coalesce and `tl.dot` can be used.
- In the GroupNorm kernel, GROUP_SIZE=8 is tiny; BLOCK=256 with a [256,8] tile wastes warps. Increase BLOCK to 1024 and use num_warps=8; fuse passes with online Welford so we read x once instead of twice (HW=66564 per group, currently read 2× = ~270 MB per program × 1024 programs).
large_guidance:
- Restructure the conv as a true im2col-style GEMM in NHWC: one program per (N, OH*OW tile, OC tile), accumulate via `tl.dot` over a (KH*KW*IC) K-dimension tiled with BLOCK_K=32. Pre-transpose weights to [KH*KW*IC, OC] at init. This lets the 4090 hit tensor-core-style fp32 throughput via `tl.dot` and fixes the current scalar outer-product accumulation (BLOCK_HW×BLOCK_OC = 64×64 with no dot product is severely under-utilizing the SM).
- Fuse conv+bias+GELU+GroupNorm-pass1 into a single kernel that, while computing the output tile in NHWC, also accumulates per-(N,group) partial sum and sum-of-squares into a small workspace `[N, num_groups]` via atomic adds. Then a tiny second kernel finalizes mean/rstd and a third applies the affine normalization. This removes one full read of the 128*64*258*258 ≈ 8.5M-element tensor between conv and GN.
- Alternatively, since out_channels=64 fits entirely in one OC tile, make the conv kernel persistent over OC and stream OH*OW tiles, keeping accumulators in registers and emitting GroupNorm partial stats per tile — collapses the conv→GN pipeline into one launch.
